description: This file defines the 'Article' class in the Conduit.Domain namespace, representing an article entity with properties such as Id, Slug, Title, Description, Body, Author, Comments, and related metadata including favorites and tags.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Class representing an article with properties for article details, author, comments, tags, and favorites.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has been favorited by any user.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of how many users have favorited the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Provides a list of tags associated with the article.
